title: Random and Sequential Order Finger Motor Imagery
description: EEG recordings from 20 participants performing a novel finger motor imagery paradigm in which cues for individual fingers were presented in random and sequential order blocks. The order of blocks was counterbalanced across participants. Data were acquired with a 65-channel g.tec system at 512 Hz and organized in BIDS format.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.tec GmbH system at 512 Hz using 65 channels (62 EEG, 2 reference, 1 marker channel). Participants performed cued finger motor imagery (thumb, index, middle, ring, pinky) in random and sequential cue-order blocks, with block order counterbalanced. Data are stored as EDF files with BIDS sidecars.
